quality_floor: 1,560+ tests and 85%+ branch coverage at v0.6.3

local_validation.scope: the maintainer's workstation, where the GPU and Windows-specific paths actually run
local_validation.commit_relationship: final pull-request head; the squash merge that became the release commit has a different hash and was not itself measured here

cpu_non_gpu_non_network.skip_reason: symlink creation requires privileges on Windows; hard-link and case aliases cover the same guard

release_validation.scope: the exact published commit, validated by CI rather than locally
release_validation.gpu_coverage: none; no GPU runner is configured for this repository, so the GPU counts above exist only from the local measurement
